purpose: Define the dry-run policy for a single human-approval state transition (approval_pack_ready → human_review_pending). This phase ONLY simulates the transition; it does NOT modify the real approval state, does NOT approve, does NOT promote, and does NOT write to production.
required_confirm_phrase: DRY RUN DAILY HUMAN APPROVAL TRANSITION
env_gate_evaluated_note: this script does not read process.env; env_gate_evaluated is conservatively false; an external orchestrator must verify the env gate before any real transition

ui_indicators.primary_warning_en: This phase only simulates the approval_pack_ready → human_review_pending transition. It does not actually approve, does not enable promote, does not write production, and does not send Telegram.
